stages.scope: Inventory ownership and establish workspace contracts

stages.evidence: All 248 baseline route entries preserved; three production builds; web/API projections and membership frontend rendering verified; docs/validation-build.json; docs/validation-admin-browser.md

stages.scope: Extract worker and remove old duplicate execution entry
stages.evidence: docs/validation-worker.json; Windows IPC shutdown and Linux SIGTERM; no web/API timer owner

stages.scope: Integrated validation, release and rollback verification
stages.completedIncrement: Actual shared database upgraded to 53 migrations, new version cutover, four root-owned children with one worker, public HTTP and actual-account browser workflows verified

membershipOwnership.ui: web/admin feature directories after application extraction

invariants: Client applications cannot import database, secrets or backend implementation
HTTP adapters do not own business rules
Cross-module callers use explicit public interfaces
Membership prices, entitlements and refund rules come from backend configuration
Paid order snapshots are immutable and fulfillment/refunds are idempotent
Use one shared database initially; do not claim distributed SQLite scalability
Do not enable real payment or deploy unverified changes
Do not mark structural migration complete while legacy ownership or duplicate implementations remain
stageGates: Applicable browser workflows and frontend/backend data association
Single task execution ownership and rollback readiness
